[PREFERENCE] User is curious to learn more about current trends in cloud security.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cloud security is a rapidly evolving field with new trends to learn.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trend 1: Cloud-Native Security - need for solutions designed for cloud-based workloads.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trend 2: Zero-Trust Architecture - verification of every user, device, and application.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trend 3: Serverless Security - new challenges with serverless computing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trend 4: Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) - monitoring and managing cloud security posture.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trend 5: DevSecOps - integration of security practices into DevOps workflows.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trend 6: AI/ML in Cloud Security - improving threat detection and incident response.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trend 7: Cloud Access Security Brokers (CASBs) - monitoring and controlling cloud usage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trend 8: Compliance and Governance - addressing regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cloudflare provides security at the edge of the network.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Security at the edge reduces latency, improves security, and increases scalability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Key security features of Cloudflare include Web Application Firewall (WAF), DDoS Protection, SSL/TLS Encryption, and CDN.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cloudflare Access is a Zero-Trust solution for secure access to applications.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cloudflare Gateway provides secure, filtered internet access for devices and users.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cloudflare Spectrum provides security and performance for TCP-based applications.  
[FACT] User is interested in learning more about Cloudflare's new security features.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cloudflare's WAF filters incoming traffic to block malicious requests.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] WAF can detect and block SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF), and DoS/DDoS attacks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] WAF rules can be configured for IP blocking, User Agent blocking, and rate limiting.
